g.text: India’s EloElo nabs $80M from NBCUniversal to bet on the country’s rising microdrama market ◆ Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity ◆ Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows ◆ Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom ◆ Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal ◆ Orbital Matter 3D-printed the first rigid beam in the vacuum of space ◆
